# migadu_forwarding (Data Source)

Fetches information about a Migadu mailbox forwarding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "migadu_forwarding" "example" {
  domain_name        = "example.com"
  mailbox_local_part = "alice"
  address            = "alice@personal.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The forwarding destination address.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain of the mailbox.
- `mailbox_local_part` (String) The local part of the mailbox.

### Read-Only

- `blocked_at` (String) When the forwarding was blocked.
- `confirmation_sent_at` (String) When the confirmation was sent.
- `confirmed_at` (String) When the forwarding was confirmed.
- `expires_on` (String) When the forwarding expires.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the forwarding is active.
- `remove_upon_expiry` (Boolean) Whether to remove the forwarding upon expiry.
